title: Photosynthesis overview
text: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert light into chemical energy. It occurs mainly in the chloroplast. In simple terms, light, water, and carbon dioxide are used to produce glucose and oxygen. This explanation introduces the basic concept and gives a concise definition.

title: Reasoning example
text: Question: Why does ice float on water? Answer: Ice is less dense than liquid water because hydrogen bonds keep water molecules farther apart in the solid state. Therefore, the same mass occupies more volume, which lowers density and causes floating.

title: Rare niche topic
text: Braille music notation is a tactile system that allows blind musicians to read music through patterns of raised dots. Although it appears in a much smaller set of texts than standard notation, it represents an important rare pattern in educational and accessibility-related material.
